verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I don't wanna talk about You
Like You're not in the room
I wanna look right at You
I wanna sing right to You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Give me dove's eyes
Give me undistracted devotion
For only You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I believe You are listening
I believe that You move at the sound of my voice
